Manifold DualMC solves this by precomputing a lookup table that maps these problematic configurations to their ambiguous face direction, allowing the algorithm to check neighboring cells and invert the cell code when necessary to ensure consistent manifold connectivity [S2, S3].

The evidence in Source [S2] explicitly describes the generation of a lookup table (`problematicConfigs`) that maps cube configurations (0-255) to an ambiguous face direction (or 255 if non-problematic). This aligns perfectly with the claim that the algorithm precomputes this table to check neighbors and invert the cell code for consistent manifold connectivity.
